name: 40676-sharedprefix-31b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, 4 of its 8 cards.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one in-process vLLM engine; no router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration multimodal instruct decoder, 31B in bf16, ~62.6 GB of weights, ungated apache-2.0; the workload is text only, so the vision tower loads and is never invoked.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 150 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed static 40676.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, text only: 30 distinct prefixes of 28000 tokens, one drawn at random per request, plus 256 unique prompt tokens and exactly 400 generated tokens.
purpose: A document analysis assistant answering single questions on long shared reference texts, one stream at a time across four GPUs.
launch:
# `vllm serve --config` for this item. The engine is a source checkout rather than a
# release; the interpreter to use is named in configs/env.yaml. Anything not listed here
# stands at the engine's own default for this device -- block-size, dtype, kv-cache-dtype,
# quantization and max-num-seqs among them.
model: google/gemma-4-31B-it
tensor-parallel-size: 4
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
# 28000 prefix + 256 unique + 400 generated = 28,656 tokens must clear.
max-model-len: 32768

# PINNED, not tuned, and it is an admission gate rather than a sizing choice. This engine's
# own default is 0.92 (config/cache.py: `gpu_memory_utilization: float = Field(default=0.92`),
# and `v1/worker/utils.py: request_memory` REFUSES TO START when free memory is below
# util x total -- 0.92 x 79.19 = 72.85 GiB on an H100 80GB, i.e. it demands a card that is
# essentially pristine. This node is shared and repeatedly offered 68.39 GiB free on all four
# cards, so every start was rejected and the engine served nothing. 0.82 asks 64.94 GiB and
# tolerates ~14 GiB of foreign residency.
# It also pins the KV pool: available KV = util x total - non-KV - cudagraphs
# (v1/worker/gpu_worker.py:450) and never reads foreign residency, so a pinned util is the
# only way to give every run a byte-identical pool.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.82
